modern_position_audit.color_note: Reported candidate-counterpart g-r values are mostly below 1; if physical, the 2021 paper considers F/G/K stars or star-forming galaxies more plausible than very-red M-dwarf flare stars.

connection_matrix.evidence: 1950 detections vanish in later surveys; GTC nearby sources are chance-compatible.
A modern star must be propagated back to epoch 1950.28 before identity linkage can be tested.
Colors permit stellar or star-forming-galaxy possibilities but no host identity is established.
4-5-6 are nearly collinear; broader work reports aligned multiple-transient events.
Hambly & Blair 2024 favor spurious copy/emulsion artifacts; original-negative provenance remains unresolved.
JPFM-1 reproduces the sub-second kinematic gate; fast-flash morphology remains a competing interpretation.
2025 peer-reviewed association is challenged by schedule-normalized 2026 reanalysis and supported by another 2026 replication.
2025 paper reports a small UAP-count/transient-count association; it does not identify this nine-source event.
Population-level shadow-deficit analyses disagree across 2025-2026 studies.

required_JPFM_2B: Recover authoritative WCS coordinates for transients 1, 7 and 8; never estimate them by eye.
Run live Gaia DR3/DR4-when-available, Pan-STARRS, SDSS, Legacy Surveys, SIMBAD/NED and variable/transient catalog cone searches at 0.5, 1.0, 1.7, 3 and 5 arcsec.
Propagate Gaia proper motions backward to epoch 1950.28 and score intersection with each transient position and astrometric uncertainty.
For extended sources, measure morphology/redshift/host probability rather than accepting nearest-neighbor identity.
Build identical-WCS multi-epoch cutouts from POSS-I blue/red, later POSS-I red, POSS-II, SDSS, Pan-STARRS, GTC and later deep imaging.
Freeze line/arc/cluster statistic before evaluating all nine coordinates and apply plate-wide look-elsewhere correction.
Retrieve the exact 107875-candidate catalog with plate IDs, exposure timestamps and original/copy/scanner provenance and build the plate-day exposure matrix.
Keep coordinate evidence, plate morphology evidence and population-level temporal correlations as separate likelihood factors until a common generative model is tested.

aggregate_verdict.key_result: The strongest next coordinate test is backward Gaia astrometry plus complete-nine frozen geometry, not nearest-object storytelling.
